error_message: PPSh aim pose with the support hand at the exact hip place: the thumb and the fingertips stand up on both sides of the rear sight (9.8 % of the centre box is hand; Type 100: 11.8 %)
root_cause: The hip idle holds the PPSh right behind the drum with the thumb up the receiver's left side, 4.4 u ahead of the weapon tag - that is about 3 u in front of the eye in the aim, so a hand that is unremarkable at the hip flanks the sights. The Type 100's hip hand lies on its side magazine at sight height.
fix: Per-gun nudge of the hip relation in the camera frame, kept inside the matrix's 1.5 u: PPSh 1.2 u lower (hand cups the back of the drum, 0.1 % of the box), Type 100 (0, 1.05, -0.95) = 1.4 u (1.9 % against 0.9 % released; the pistol lane's first pose was 2.0 u off). Engine run sa2: box cover of the settled aim is LOWER than with the released pose for both (PPSh 17.1 vs 20.1 %, Type 100 21.2 vs 26.1 %).
